```markdown file=spec.md
# Document and payment service

## Interface

The service is a Python module `solution.py` that defines a class `Service`.
Tests call it in-process; there is no network. Every method returns a pair
`(status, body)`, where `status` is an HTTP-style integer and `body` is a
`dict`, a `list`, or `None`.

    class Service:
        def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600): ...
        def register(self, username, password): ...                 # 201 | 400 | 409
        def login(self, username, password): ...                    # 200 {"token": str} | 401
        def logout(self, token): ...                                # 204 | 401
        def create_document(self, token, title, content): ...       # 201 {"id": str} | 400 | 401
        def get_document(self, token, doc_id): ...                  # 200 doc | 401 | 404
        def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content): ...  # 200 doc | 400 | 401 | 404
        def delete_document(self, token, doc_id): ...               # 204 | 401 | 404
        def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None): ...
            # 200 {"items": [doc, ...], "next_cursor": str | None} | 400 | 401
        def search_documents(self, token, query): ...               # 200 [doc, ...] | 400 | 401
        def export_documents(self, token): ...                      # 200 [doc, ...] | 401
        def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key): ...
            # 201 payment | 200 payment | 400 | 401 | 409 | 504
        def list_payments(self, token): ...                         # 200 [payment, ...] | 401

A document is `{"id", "owner", "title", "content", "created_at"}`. A payment is
`{"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}`. In both, `created_at`
is the value of `clock.now()` when the object was created.

`clock` is an object with a method `now()` that returns the current time in
seconds as a float. The service never reads the system time.

`gateway` is an object with a method `charge(reference, amount_cents)`. Calling
it twice with the same `reference` charges at most once. It can raise
`GatewayTimeout` (importable as `from gateway import GatewayTimeout`); the
outcome of the charge is then unknown.

## Requirements

**REQ-14 Authentication.** `register` creates a user. A username is 3 to 32
characters from `[a-z0-9_]`, and a password is at least 8 characters;
otherwise the result is 400. An existing username gives 409. `login` with
correct credentials returns a new token; otherwise 401. A token is valid for
`token_ttl` seconds after its creation: it is accepted while
`clock.now() < created + token_ttl` and rejected from that instant on. Every
method that takes a token returns 401 for a missing, unknown, expired, or
revoked token. The *caller* of a method is the user the token belongs to.

**REQ-15 Logout.** `logout` revokes the given token. A revoked token is
rejected by every method. Other tokens of the same user stay valid.

**REQ-16 Document creation.** `create_document` stores a document owned by
the caller and returns its id. A title is 1 to 200 characters, and content is
at most 100,000 characters; otherwise 400. Ids are unique for the lifetime of
the service and are never reused.

**REQ-17 Ownership.** A user can read only the documents they own. For users
A and B with A != B, no response to a request by A contains a document owned
by B, whatever the method (get, list, search, export, update, delete). A
request by A on a document of B returns 404, exactly as for a document that
does not exist.

**REQ-18 Update and deletion.** Only the owner can update or delete a
document. Update validates title and content as in REQ-16. A deleted document
is never returned again by any method, and further get, update, or delete on
it return 404.

**REQ-19 Listing.** `list_documents` returns the caller's documents in
creation order, oldest first, in pages of `page_size` items (1 to 100,
otherwise 400). `next_cursor` is `None` on the last page. Following the
cursors from the first page returns every document of the caller exactly
once. Documents deleted after a cursor was issued are not returned;
documents created after it appear on later pages; no document is returned
twice and no remaining document is skipped. A cursor that was not issued to
the caller gives 400.

**REQ-20 Search.** `search_documents` returns the caller's documents whose
title or content contains `query`, ignoring case, in creation order. An
empty query gives 400.

**REQ-21 Export.** `export_documents` returns all documents of the caller,
in creation order. Updating a document does not change its position in any
ordering.

**REQ-22 Payments.** `pay` charges `amount_cents` through the gateway and
records a payment for the caller. The amount is an integer from 1 to
1,000,000; otherwise 400. A new payment returns 201. `list_payments` returns
the caller's recorded payments in creation order. If the gateway raises
`GatewayTimeout`, `pay` returns 504 and records no payment.

**REQ-23 Idempotency.** Retrying a payment never creates a second
transaction. Idempotency keys are scoped to the caller. A `pay` with a key
the caller already used and the same amount returns 200 with the original
payment and records nothing new; with a different amount it returns 409.
This holds also when the earlier attempt returned 504: a retry with the same
key and amount completes the payment (status 200 or 201) once the gateway
answers, and results in at most one recorded payment and at most one charge.
```

I implemented `Service` with a single lock around every method, and wrote the unit tests below. I have not run either file. The spec leaves a few choices open, and I resolved them as follows:

- **Pagination:** a cursor is an opaque random string stored with its owner and the sequence number of the last document returned. Deletions therefore cannot cause skips or repeats, and a cursor issued to another user gives 400.
- **Idempotency and timeouts:** the amount for a key is remembered on the first attempt, even if the gateway times out. A retry with a different amount then gives 409, and a retry with the same amount reuses the same gateway reference. The reference is `username:key`, which scopes it to the caller.
- **Update:** a missing or foreign document returns 404 before body validation returns 400.
- **Tokens:** an expired token passed to `logout` returns 401.

```python file=solution.py
import hashlib
import hmac
import re
import secrets
import threading

try:
    from gateway import GatewayTimeout
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    class GatewayTimeout(Exception):
        pass

_USERNAME_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9_]{3,32}")


def _is_int(v):
    return isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)


class Service:
    def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600):
        self._clock = clock
        self._gateway = gateway
        self._ttl = token_ttl
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._users = {}            # username -> (salt, hash)
        self._tokens = {}           # token -> (username, created)
        self._docs = {}             # doc_id -> doc dict (with hidden seq in _seqs)
        self._seqs = {}             # doc_id -> seq
        self._user_docs = {}        # username -> list of doc ids in creation order
        self._doc_counter = 0
        self._cursors = {}          # cursor -> (username, last_seq)
        self._payments = {}         # username -> list of payment dicts
        self._pay_keys = {}         # (username, key) -> {"amount": int, "payment": dict|None}
        self._pay_counter = 0

    # ---------- helpers ----------
    @staticmethod
    def _hash(salt, password):
        return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", password.encode("utf-8"), salt, 1000)

    def _auth(self, token):
        if not isinstance(token, str):
            return None
        entry = self._tokens.get(token)
        if entry is None:
            return None
        user, created = entry
        if self._clock.now() < created + self._ttl:
            return user
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_doc_fields(title, content):
        if not isinstance(title, str) or not isinstance(content, str):
            return False
        if not (1 <= len(title) <= 200):
            return False
        if len(content) > 100000:
            return False
        return True

    def _owned(self, user, doc_id):
        if not isinstance(doc_id, str):
            return None
        doc = self._docs.get(doc_id)
        if doc is None or doc["owner"] != user:
            return None
        return doc

    # ---------- auth ----------
    def register(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not _USERNAME_RE.fullmatch(username):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(password, str) or len(password) < 8:
                return 400, None
            if username in self._users:
                return 409, None
            salt = secrets.token_bytes(16)
            self._users[username] = (salt, self._hash(salt, password))
            self._user_docs[username] = []
            self._payments[username] = []
            return 201, None

    def login(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 401, None
            rec = self._users.get(username)
            if rec is None:
                return 401, None
            salt, h = rec
            if not hmac.compare_digest(h, self._hash(salt, password)):
                return 401, None
            token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            self._tokens[token] = (username, self._clock.now())
            return 200, {"token": token}

    def logout(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            if self._auth(token) is None:
                return 401, None
            del self._tokens[token]
            return 204, None

    # ---------- documents ----------
    def create_document(self, token, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            self._doc_counter += 1
            doc_id = "doc-%d" % self._doc_counter
            self._docs[doc_id] = {
                "id": doc_id,
                "owner": user,
                "title": title,
                "content": content,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            self._seqs[doc_id] = self._doc_counter
            self._user_docs[user].append(doc_id)
            return 201, {"id": doc_id}

    def get_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            doc["title"] = title
            doc["content"] = content
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def delete_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            del self._docs[doc_id]
            del self._seqs[doc_id]
            self._user_docs[user].remove(doc_id)
            return 204, None

    def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(page_size) or not (1 <= page_size <= 100):
                return 400, None
            last_seq = 0
            if cursor is not None:
                if not isinstance(cursor, str):
                    return 400, None
                entry = self._cursors.get(cursor)
                if entry is None or entry[0] != user:
                    return 400, None
                last_seq = entry[1]
            remaining = [d for d in self._user_docs[user] if self._seqs[d] > last_seq]
            page = remaining[:page_size]
            next_cursor = None
            if len(remaining) > page_size:
                next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(16)
                self._cursors[next_cursor] = (user, self._seqs[page[-1]])
            return 200, {
                "items": [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in page],
                "next_cursor": next_cursor,
            }

    def search_documents(self, token, query):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not isinstance(query, str) or query == "":
                return 400, None
            q = query.casefold()
            result = []
            for d in self._user_docs[user]:
                doc = self._docs[d]
                if q in doc["title"].casefold() or q in doc["content"].casefold():
                    result.append(dict(doc))
            return 200, result

    def export_documents(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in self._user_docs[user]]

    # ---------- payments ----------
    def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(amount_cents) or not (1 <= amount_cents <= 1000000):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or idempotency_key == "":
                return 400, None
            rec = self._pay_keys.get((user, idempotency_key))
            if rec is None:
                rec = {"amount": amount_cents, "payment": None}
                self._pay_keys[(user, idempotency_key)] = rec
            elif rec["amount"] != amount_cents:
                return 409, None
            elif rec["payment"] is not None:
                return 200, dict(rec["payment"])
            reference = "%s:%s" % (user, idempotency_key)
            try:
                self._gateway.charge(reference, amount_cents)
            except GatewayTimeout:
                return 504, None
            self._pay_counter += 1
            payment = {
                "id": "pay-%d" % self._pay_counter,
                "amount_cents": amount_cents,
                "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            rec["payment"] = payment
            self._payments[user].append(payment)
            return 201, dict(payment)

    def list_payments(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(p) for p in self._payments[user]]
```

```python file=test_solution.py
from solution import Service

try:
    from gateway import GatewayTimeout
except ImportError:
    class GatewayTimeout(Exception):
        pass


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class Gateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.charges = {}
        self.calls = 0
        self.fail_next = 0       # raise timeout this many times (charge applied or not)
        self.apply_on_fail = False

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls += 1
        if self.fail_next > 0:
            self.fail_next -= 1
            if self.apply_on_fail:
                self.charges.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        self.charges.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
```

```markdown file=spec.md
`{"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}`. In both, `created_at`
is the value of `clock.now()` when the object was created.

`clock` is an object with a method `now()` that returns the current time in
seconds as a float. The service never reads the system time.

`gateway` is an object with a method `charge(reference, amount_cents)`. Calling
it twice with the same `reference` charges at most once. It can raise
`GatewayTimeout` (importable as `from gateway import GatewayTimeout`); the
outcome of the charge is then unknown.

characters from `[a-z0-9_]`, and a password is at least 8 characters;
otherwise the result is 400. An existing username gives 409. `login` with

`token_ttl` seconds after its creation: it is accepted while
`clock.now() < created + token_ttl` and rejected from that instant on. Every
method that takes a token returns 401 for a missing, unknown, expired, or
revoked token. The *caller* of a method is the user the token belongs to.

rejected by every method. Other tokens of the same user stay valid.

the caller and returns its id. A title is 1 to 200 characters, and content is
at most 100,000 characters; otherwise 400. Ids are unique for the lifetime of
the service and are never reused.

request by A on a document of B returns 404, exactly as for a document that
does not exist.

**REQ-18 Update and deletion.** Only the owner can update or delete a

documents created after it appear on later pages; no document is returned

the caller gives 400.
```

```python file=test_phase_a.py
def test_ownership_no_leak_property(nA, nB, p, q):
```

```python file=solution.py
import hashlib
import hmac
import re
import secrets
import threading

try:
    from gateway import GatewayTimeout
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    class GatewayTimeout(Exception):
        pass

_USERNAME_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9_]{3,32}")


def _is_int(v):
    return isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)


class Service:
    def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600):
        self._clock = clock
        self._gateway = gateway
        self._ttl = token_ttl
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._users = {}            # username -> (salt, hash)
        self._tokens = {}           # token -> (username, created)
        self._docs = {}             # doc_id -> doc dict (with hidden seq in _seqs)
        self._seqs = {}             # doc_id -> seq
        self._user_docs = {}        # username -> list of doc ids in creation order
        self._doc_counter = 0
        self._cursors = {}          # cursor -> (username, last_seq)
        self._payments = {}         # username -> list of payment dicts
        self._pay_keys = {}         # (username, key) -> {"amount": int, "payment": dict|None}
        self._pay_counter = 0

    # ---------- helpers ----------
    @staticmethod
    def _hash(salt, password):
        return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", password.encode("utf-8"), salt, 1000)

    def _auth(self, token):
        if not isinstance(token, str):
            return None
        entry = self._tokens.get(token)
        if entry is None:
            return None
        user, created = entry
        if self._clock.now() < created + self._ttl:
            return user
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_doc_fields(title, content):
        if not isinstance(title, str) or not isinstance(content, str):
            return False
        if not (1 <= len(title) <= 200):
            return False
        if len(content) > 100000:
            return False
        return True

    def _owned(self, user, doc_id):
        if not isinstance(doc_id, str):
            return None
        doc = self._docs.get(doc_id)
        if doc is None or doc["owner"] != user:
            return None
        return doc

    # ---------- auth ----------
    def register(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not _USERNAME_RE.fullmatch(username):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(password, str) or len(password) < 8:
                return 400, None
            if username in self._users:
                return 409, None
            salt = secrets.token_bytes(16)
            self._users[username] = (salt, self._hash(salt, password))
            self._user_docs[username] = []
            self._payments[username] = []
            return 201, None

    def login(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 401, None
            rec = self._users.get(username)
            if rec is None:
                return 401, None
            salt, h = rec
            if not hmac.compare_digest(h, self._hash(salt, password)):
                return 401, None
            token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            self._tokens[token] = (username, self._clock.now())
            return 200, {"token": token}

    def logout(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            if self._auth(token) is None:
                return 401, None
            del self._tokens[token]
            return 204, None

    # ---------- documents ----------
    def create_document(self, token, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            self._doc_counter += 1
            doc_id = "doc-%d" % self._doc_counter
            self._docs[doc_id] = {
                "id": doc_id,
                "owner": user,
                "title": title,
                "content": content,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            self._seqs[doc_id] = self._doc_counter
            self._user_docs[user].append(doc_id)
            return 201, {"id": doc_id}

    def get_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            doc["title"] = title
            doc["content"] = content
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def delete_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            del self._docs[doc_id]
            del self._seqs[doc_id]
            self._user_docs[user].remove(doc_id)
            return 204, None

    def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(page_size) or not (1 <= page_size <= 100):
                return 400, None
            last_seq = 0
            if cursor is not None:
                if not isinstance(cursor, str):
                    return 400, None
                entry = self._cursors.get(cursor)
                if entry is None or entry[0] != user:
                    return 400, None
                last_seq = entry[1]
            remaining = [d for d in self._user_docs[user] if self._seqs[d] > last_seq]
            page = remaining[:page_size]
            next_cursor = None
            if len(remaining) > page_size:
                next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(16)
                self._cursors[next_cursor] = (user, self._seqs[page[-1]])
            return 200, {
                "items": [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in page],
                "next_cursor": next_cursor,
            }

    def search_documents(self, token, query):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not isinstance(query, str) or query == "":
                return 400, None
            q = query.casefold()
            result = []
            for d in self._user_docs[user]:
                doc = self._docs[d]
                if q in doc["title"].casefold() or q in doc["content"].casefold():
                    result.append(dict(doc))
            return 200, result

    def export_documents(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in self._user_docs[user]]

    # ---------- payments ----------
    def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(amount_cents) or not (1 <= amount_cents <= 1000000):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or idempotency_key == "":
                return 400, None
            rec = self._pay_keys.get((user, idempotency_key))
            if rec is None:
                rec = {"amount": amount_cents, "payment": None}
                self._pay_keys[(user, idempotency_key)] = rec
            elif rec["amount"] != amount_cents:
                return 409, None
            elif rec["payment"] is not None:
                return 200, dict(rec["payment"])
            reference = "%s:%s" % (user, idempotency_key)
            try:
                self._gateway.charge(reference, amount_cents)
            except GatewayTimeout:
                return 504, None
            self._pay_counter += 1
            payment = {
                "id": "pay-%d" % self._pay_counter,
                "amount_cents": amount_cents,
                "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            rec["payment"] = payment
            self._payments[user].append(payment)
            return 201, dict(payment)

    def list_payments(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(p) for p in self._payments[user]]
```

```python file=test_solution.py
class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class Gateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.charges = {}
        self.calls = 0
        self.fail_next = 0       # raise timeout this many times (charge applied or not)
        self.apply_on_fail = False

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls += 1
        if self.fail_next > 0:
            self.fail_next -= 1
            if self.apply_on_fail:
                self.charges.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        self.charges.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
```

```python file=solution.py
import hashlib
import hmac
import re
import secrets
import threading

try:
    from gateway import GatewayTimeout
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    class GatewayTimeout(Exception):
        pass

_USERNAME_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9_]{3,32}")


def _is_int(v):
    return isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)


class Service:
    def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600):
        self._clock = clock
        self._gateway = gateway
        self._ttl = token_ttl
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._users = {}            # username -> (salt, hash)
        self._tokens = {}           # token -> (username, created)
        self._docs = {}             # doc_id -> doc dict (with hidden seq in _seqs)
        self._seqs = {}             # doc_id -> seq
        self._user_docs = {}        # username -> list of doc ids in creation order
        self._doc_counter = 0
        self._cursors = {}          # cursor -> (username, last_seq)
        self._payments = {}         # username -> list of payment dicts
        self._pay_keys = {}         # (username, key) -> {"amount": int, "payment": dict|None}
        self._pay_counter = 0

    # ---------- helpers ----------
    @staticmethod
    def _hash(salt, password):
        return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", password.encode("utf-8"), salt, 1000)

    def _auth(self, token):
        if not isinstance(token, str):
            return None
        entry = self._tokens.get(token)
        if entry is None:
            return None
        user, created = entry
        if self._clock.now() < created + self._ttl:
            return user
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_doc_fields(title, content):
        if not isinstance(title, str) or not isinstance(content, str):
            return False
        if not (1 <= len(title) <= 200):
            return False
        if len(content) > 100000:
            return False
        return True

    def _owned(self, user, doc_id):
        if not isinstance(doc_id, str):
            return None
        doc = self._docs.get(doc_id)
        if doc is None or doc["owner"] != user:
            return None
        return doc

    # ---------- auth ----------
    def register(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not _USERNAME_RE.fullmatch(username):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(password, str) or len(password) < 8:
                return 400, None
            if username in self._users:
                return 409, None
            salt = secrets.token_bytes(16)
            self._users[username] = (salt, self._hash(salt, password))
            self._user_docs[username] = []
            self._payments[username] = []
            return 201, None

    def login(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 401, None
            rec = self._users.get(username)
            if rec is None:
                return 401, None
            salt, h = rec
            if not hmac.compare_digest(h, self._hash(salt, password)):
                return 401, None
            token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            self._tokens[token] = (username, self._clock.now())
            return 200, {"token": token}

    def logout(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            if self._auth(token) is None:
                return 401, None
            del self._tokens[token]
            return 204, None

    # ---------- documents ----------
    def create_document(self, token, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            self._doc_counter += 1
            doc_id = "doc-%d" % self._doc_counter
            self._docs[doc_id] = {
                "id": doc_id,
                "owner": user,
                "title": title,
                "content": content,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            self._seqs[doc_id] = self._doc_counter
            self._user_docs[user].append(doc_id)
            return 201, {"id": doc_id}

    def get_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            doc["title"] = title
            doc["content"] = content
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def delete_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            del self._docs[doc_id]
            del self._seqs[doc_id]
            self._user_docs[user].remove(doc_id)
            return 204, None

    def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(page_size) or not (1 <= page_size <= 100):
                return 400, None
            last_seq = 0
            if cursor is not None:
                if not isinstance(cursor, str):
                    return 400, None
                entry = self._cursors.get(cursor)
                if entry is None or entry[0] != user:
                    return 400, None
                last_seq = entry[1]
            remaining = [d for d in self._user_docs[user] if self._seqs[d] > last_seq]
            page = remaining[:page_size]
            next_cursor = None
            if len(remaining) > page_size:
                next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(16)
                self._cursors[next_cursor] = (user, self._seqs[page[-1]])
            return 200, {
                "items": [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in page],
                "next_cursor": next_cursor,
            }

    def search_documents(self, token, query):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not isinstance(query, str) or query == "":
                return 400, None
            q = query.casefold()
            result = []
            for d in self._user_docs[user]:
                doc = self._docs[d]
                if q in doc["title"].casefold() or q in doc["content"].casefold():
                    result.append(dict(doc))
            return 200, result

    def export_documents(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in self._user_docs[user]]

    # ---------- payments ----------
    def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(amount_cents) or not (1 <= amount_cents <= 1000000):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or idempotency_key == "":
                return 400, None
            rec = self._pay_keys.get((user, idempotency_key))
            if rec is None:
                rec = {"amount": amount_cents, "payment": None}
                self._pay_keys[(user, idempotency_key)] = rec
            elif rec["amount"] != amount_cents:
                return 409, None
            elif rec["payment"] is not None:
                return 200, dict(rec["payment"])
            reference = "%s:%s" % (user, idempotency_key)
            try:
                self._gateway.charge(reference, amount_cents)
            except GatewayTimeout:
                return 504, None
            self._pay_counter += 1
            payment = {
                "id": "pay-%d" % self._pay_counter,
                "amount_cents": amount_cents,
                "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            rec["payment"] = payment
            self._payments[user].append(payment)
            return 201, dict(payment)

    def list_payments(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(p) for p in self._payments[user]]
```

```python file=solution.py
import hashlib
import hmac
import re
import secrets
import threading

try:
    from gateway import GatewayTimeout
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    class GatewayTimeout(Exception):
        pass

_USERNAME_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9_]{3,32}")


def _is_int(v):
    return isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)


class Service:
    def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600):
        self._clock = clock
        self._gateway = gateway
        self._ttl = token_ttl
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._users = {}            # username -> (salt, hash)
        self._tokens = {}           # token -> (username, created)
        self._docs = {}             # doc_id -> doc dict (with hidden seq in _seqs)
        self._seqs = {}             # doc_id -> seq
        self._user_docs = {}        # username -> list of doc ids in creation order
        self._doc_counter = 0
        self._cursors = {}          # cursor -> (username, last_seq)
        self._payments = {}         # username -> list of payment dicts
        self._pay_keys = {}         # (username, key) -> {"amount": int, "payment": dict|None}
        self._pay_counter = 0

    # ---------- helpers ----------
    @staticmethod
    def _hash(salt, password):
        return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", password.encode("utf-8"), salt, 1000)

    def _auth(self, token):
        if not isinstance(token, str):
            return None
        entry = self._tokens.get(token)
        if entry is None:
            return None
        user, created = entry
        if self._clock.now() < created + self._ttl:
            return user
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_doc_fields(title, content):
        if not isinstance(title, str) or not isinstance(content, str):
            return False
        if not (1 <= len(title) <= 200):
            return False
        if len(content) > 100000:
            return False
        return True

    def _owned(self, user, doc_id):
        if not isinstance(doc_id, str):
            return None
        doc = self._docs.get(doc_id)
        if doc is None or doc["owner"] != user:
            return None
        return doc

    # ---------- auth ----------
    def register(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not _USERNAME_RE.fullmatch(username):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(password, str) or len(password) < 8:
                return 400, None
            if username in self._users:
                return 409, None
            salt = secrets.token_bytes(16)
            self._users[username] = (salt, self._hash(salt, password))
            self._user_docs[username] = []
            self._payments[username] = []
            return 201, None

    def login(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 401, None
            rec = self._users.get(username)
            if rec is None:
                return 401, None
            salt, h = rec
            if not hmac.compare_digest(h, self._hash(salt, password)):
                return 401, None
            token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            self._tokens[token] = (username, self._clock.now())
            return 200, {"token": token}

    def logout(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            if self._auth(token) is None:
                return 401, None
            del self._tokens[token]
            return 204, None

    # ---------- documents ----------
    def create_document(self, token, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            self._doc_counter += 1
            doc_id = "doc-%d" % self._doc_counter
            self._docs[doc_id] = {
                "id": doc_id,
                "owner": user,
                "title": title,
                "content": content,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            self._seqs[doc_id] = self._doc_counter
            self._user_docs[user].append(doc_id)
            return 201, {"id": doc_id}

    def get_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            doc["title"] = title
            doc["content"] = content
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def delete_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            del self._docs[doc_id]
            del self._seqs[doc_id]
            self._user_docs[user].remove(doc_id)
            return 204, None

    def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(page_size) or not (1 <= page_size <= 100):
                return 400, None
            last_seq = 0
            if cursor is not None:
                if not isinstance(cursor, str):
                    return 400, None
                entry = self._cursors.get(cursor)
                if entry is None or entry[0] != user:
                    return 400, None
                last_seq = entry[1]
            remaining = [d for d in self._user_docs[user] if self._seqs[d] > last_seq]
            page = remaining[:page_size]
            next_cursor = None
            if len(remaining) > page_size:
                next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(16)
                self._cursors[next_cursor] = (user, self._seqs[page[-1]])
            return 200, {
                "items": [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in page],
                "next_cursor": next_cursor,
            }

    def search_documents(self, token, query):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not isinstance(query, str) or query == "":
                return 400, None
            q = query.casefold()
            result = []
            for d in self._user_docs[user]:
                doc = self._docs[d]
                if q in doc["title"].casefold() or q in doc["content"].casefold():
                    result.append(dict(doc))
            return 200, result

    def export_documents(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in self._user_docs[user]]

    # ---------- payments ----------
    def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(amount_cents) or not (1 <= amount_cents <= 1000000):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or idempotency_key == "":
                return 400, None
            rec = self._pay_keys.get((user, idempotency_key))
            if rec is None:
                rec = {"amount": amount_cents, "payment": None}
                self._pay_keys[(user, idempotency_key)] = rec
            elif rec["amount"] != amount_cents:
                return 409, None
            elif rec["payment"] is not None:
                return 200, dict(rec["payment"])
            reference = "%s:%s" % (user, idempotency_key)
            try:
                self._gateway.charge(reference, amount_cents)
            except GatewayTimeout:
                return 504, None
            self._pay_counter += 1
            payment = {
                "id": "pay-%d" % self._pay_counter,
                "amount_cents": amount_cents,
                "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            rec["payment"] = payment
            self._payments[user].append(payment)
            return 201, dict(payment)

    def list_payments(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(p) for p in self._payments[user]]
```

```python file=solution.py
import hashlib
import hmac
import re
import secrets
import threading

try:
    from gateway import GatewayTimeout
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    class GatewayTimeout(Exception):
        pass

_USERNAME_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9_]{3,32}")


def _is_int(v):
    return isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)


class Service:
    def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600):
        self._clock = clock
        self._gateway = gateway
        self._ttl = token_ttl
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._users = {}            # username -> (salt, hash)
        self._tokens = {}           # token -> (username, created)
        self._docs = {}             # doc_id -> doc dict (with hidden seq in _seqs)
        self._seqs = {}             # doc_id -> seq
        self._user_docs = {}        # username -> list of doc ids in creation order
        self._doc_counter = 0
        self._cursors = {}          # cursor -> (username, last_seq)
        self._payments = {}         # username -> list of payment dicts
        self._pay_keys = {}         # (username, key) -> {"amount": int, "payment": dict|None}
        self._pay_counter = 0

    # ---------- helpers ----------
    @staticmethod
    def _hash(salt, password):
        return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", password.encode("utf-8"), salt, 1000)

    def _auth(self, token):
        if not isinstance(token, str):
            return None
        entry = self._tokens.get(token)
        if entry is None:
            return None
        user, created = entry
        if self._clock.now() < created + self._ttl:
            return user
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_doc_fields(title, content):
        if not isinstance(title, str) or not isinstance(content, str):
            return False
        if not (1 <= len(title) <= 200):
            return False
        if len(content) > 100000:
            return False
        return True

    def _owned(self, user, doc_id):
        if not isinstance(doc_id, str):
            return None
        doc = self._docs.get(doc_id)
        if doc is None or doc["owner"] != user:
            return None
        return doc

    # ---------- auth ----------
    def register(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not _USERNAME_RE.fullmatch(username):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(password, str) or len(password) < 8:
                return 400, None
            if username in self._users:
                return 409, None
            salt = secrets.token_bytes(16)
            self._users[username] = (salt, self._hash(salt, password))
            self._user_docs[username] = []
            self._payments[username] = []
            return 201, None

    def login(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 401, None
            rec = self._users.get(username)
            if rec is None:
                return 401, None
            salt, h = rec
            if not hmac.compare_digest(h, self._hash(salt, password)):
                return 401, None
            token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            self._tokens[token] = (username, self._clock.now())
            return 200, {"token": token}

    def logout(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            if self._auth(token) is None:
                return 401, None
            del self._tokens[token]
            return 204, None

    # ---------- documents ----------
    def create_document(self, token, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            self._doc_counter += 1
            doc_id = "doc-%d" % self._doc_counter
            self._docs[doc_id] = {
                "id": doc_id,
                "owner": user,
                "title": title,
                "content": content,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            self._seqs[doc_id] = self._doc_counter
            self._user_docs[user].append(doc_id)
            return 201, {"id": doc_id}

    def get_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            doc["title"] = title
            doc["content"] = content
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def delete_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            del self._docs[doc_id]
            del self._seqs[doc_id]
            self._user_docs[user].remove(doc_id)
            return 204, None

    def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(page_size) or not (1 <= page_size <= 100):
                return 400, None
            last_seq = 0
            if cursor is not None:
                if not isinstance(cursor, str):
                    return 400, None
                entry = self._cursors.get(cursor)
                if entry is None or entry[0] != user:
                    return 400, None
                last_seq = entry[1]
            remaining = [d for d in self._user_docs[user] if self._seqs[d] > last_seq]
            page = remaining[:page_size]
            next_cursor = None
            if len(remaining) > page_size:
                next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(16)
                self._cursors[next_cursor] = (user, self._seqs[page[-1]])
            return 200, {
                "items": [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in page],
                "next_cursor": next_cursor,
            }

    def search_documents(self, token, query):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not isinstance(query, str) or query == "":
                return 400, None
            q = query.casefold()
            result = []
            for d in self._user_docs[user]:
                doc = self._docs[d]
                if q in doc["title"].casefold() or q in doc["content"].casefold():
                    result.append(dict(doc))
            return 200, result

    def export_documents(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in self._user_docs[user]]

    # ---------- payments ----------
    def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(amount_cents) or not (1 <= amount_cents <= 1000000):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or idempotency_key == "":
                return 400, None
            rec = self._pay_keys.get((user, idempotency_key))
            if rec is None:
                rec = {"amount": amount_cents, "payment": None}
                self._pay_keys[(user, idempotency_key)] = rec
            elif rec["amount"] != amount_cents:
                return 409, None
            elif rec["payment"] is not None:
                return 200, dict(rec["payment"])
            reference = "%s:%s" % (user, idempotency_key)
            try:
                self._gateway.charge(reference, amount_cents)
            except GatewayTimeout:
                return 504, None
            self._pay_counter += 1
            payment = {
                "id": "pay-%d" % self._pay_counter,
                "amount_cents": amount_cents,
                "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            rec["payment"] = payment
            self._payments[user].append(payment)
            return 201, dict(payment)

    def list_payments(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(p) for p in self._payments[user]]
```

```markdown file=spec.md
# Document and payment service

## Interface

The service is a Python module `solution.py` that defines a class `Service`.
Tests call it in-process; there is no network. Every method returns a pair
`(status, body)`, where `status` is an HTTP-style integer and `body` is a
`dict`, a `list`, or `None`.

    class Service:
        def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600): ...
        def register(self, username, password): ...                 # 201 | 400 | 409
        def login(self, username, password): ...                    # 200 {"token": str} | 401
        def logout(self, token): ...                                # 204 | 401
        def create_document(self, token, title, content): ...       # 201 {"id": str} | 400 | 401
        def get_document(self, token, doc_id): ...                  # 200 doc | 401 | 404
        def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content): ...  # 200 doc | 400 | 401 | 404
        def delete_document(self, token, doc_id): ...               # 204 | 401 | 404
        def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None): ...
            # 200 {"items": [doc, ...], "next_cursor": str | None} | 400 | 401
        def search_documents(self, token, query): ...               # 200 [doc, ...] | 400 | 401
        def export_documents(self, token): ...                      # 200 [doc, ...] | 401
        def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key): ...
            # 201 payment | 200 payment | 400 | 401 | 409 | 504
        def list_payments(self, token): ...                         # 200 [payment, ...] | 401

A document is `{"id", "owner", "title", "content", "created_at"}`. A payment is
`{"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}`. In both, `created_at`
is the value of `clock.now()` when the object was created.

`clock` is an object with a method `now()` that returns the current time in
seconds as a float. The service never reads the system time.

`gateway` is an object with a method `charge(reference, amount_cents)`. Calling
it twice with the same `reference` charges at most once. It can raise
`GatewayTimeout` (importable as `from gateway import GatewayTimeout`); the
outcome of the charge is then unknown.

## Requirements

**REQ-14 Authentication.** `register` creates a user. A username is 3 to 32
characters from `[a-z0-9_]`, and a password is at least 8 characters;
otherwise the result is 400. An existing username gives 409. `login` with
correct credentials returns a new token; otherwise 401. A token is valid for
`token_ttl` seconds after its creation: it is accepted while
`clock.now() < created + token_ttl` and rejected from that instant on. Every
method that takes a token returns 401 for a missing, unknown, expired, or
revoked token. The *caller* of a method is the user the token belongs to.

**REQ-15 Logout.** `logout` revokes the given token. A revoked token is
rejected by every method. Other tokens of the same user stay valid.

**REQ-16 Document creation.** `create_document` stores a document owned by
the caller and returns its id. A title is 1 to 200 characters, and content is
at most 100,000 characters; otherwise 400. Ids are unique for the lifetime of
the service and are never reused.

**REQ-17 Ownership.** A user can read only the documents they own. For users
A and B with A != B, no response to a request by A contains a document owned
by B, whatever the method (get, list, search, export, update, delete). A
request by A on a document of B returns 404, exactly as for a document that
does not exist.

**REQ-18 Update and deletion.** Only the owner can update or delete a
document. Update validates title and content as in REQ-16. A deleted document
is never returned again by any method, and further get, update, or delete on
it return 404.

**REQ-19 Listing.** `list_documents` returns the caller's documents in
creation order, oldest first, in pages of `page_size` items (1 to 100,
otherwise 400). `next_cursor` is `None` on the last page. Following the
cursors from the first page returns every document of the caller exactly
once. Documents deleted after a cursor was issued are not returned;
documents created after it appear on later pages; no document is returned
twice and no remaining document is skipped. A cursor that was not issued to
the caller gives 400.

**REQ-20 Search.** `search_documents` returns the caller's documents whose
title or content contains `query`, ignoring case, in creation order. An
empty query gives 400.

**REQ-21 Export.** `export_documents` returns all documents of the caller,
in creation order. Updating a document does not change its position in any
ordering.

**REQ-22 Payments.** `pay` charges `amount_cents` through the gateway and
records a payment for the caller. The amount is an integer from 1 to
1,000,000; otherwise 400. A new payment returns 201. `list_payments` returns
the caller's recorded payments in creation order. If the gateway raises
`GatewayTimeout`, `pay` returns 504 and records no payment.

**REQ-23 Idempotency.** Retrying a payment never creates a second
transaction. Idempotency keys are scoped to the caller. A `pay` with a key
the caller already used and the same amount returns 200 with the original
payment and records nothing new; with a different amount it returns 409.
```

```python file=solution.py
import hashlib
import hmac
import re
import secrets
import threading

try:
    from gateway import GatewayTimeout
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    class GatewayTimeout(Exception):
        pass

_USERNAME_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9_]{3,32}")


def _is_int(v):
    return isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)


class Service:
    def __init__(self, clock, gateway, token_ttl=3600):
        self._clock = clock
        self._gateway = gateway
        self._ttl = token_ttl
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._users = {}            # username -> (salt, hash)
        self._tokens = {}           # token -> (username, created)
        self._docs = {}             # doc_id -> doc dict (with hidden seq in _seqs)
        self._seqs = {}             # doc_id -> seq
        self._user_docs = {}        # username -> list of doc ids in creation order
        self._doc_counter = 0
        self._cursors = {}          # cursor -> (username, last_seq)
        self._payments = {}         # username -> list of payment dicts
        self._pay_keys = {}         # (username, key) -> {"amount": int, "payment": dict|None}
        self._pay_counter = 0

    # ---------- helpers ----------
    @staticmethod
    def _hash(salt, password):
        return hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", password.encode("utf-8"), salt, 1000)

    def _auth(self, token):
        if not isinstance(token, str):
            return None
        entry = self._tokens.get(token)
        if entry is None:
            return None
        user, created = entry
        if self._clock.now() < created + self._ttl:
            return user
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def _valid_doc_fields(title, content):
        if not isinstance(title, str) or not isinstance(content, str):
            return False
        if not (1 <= len(title) <= 200):
            return False
        if len(content) > 100000:
            return False
        return True

    def _owned(self, user, doc_id):
        if not isinstance(doc_id, str):
            return None
        doc = self._docs.get(doc_id)
        if doc is None or doc["owner"] != user:
            return None
        return doc

    # ---------- auth ----------
    def register(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not _USERNAME_RE.fullmatch(username):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(password, str) or len(password) < 8:
                return 400, None
            if username in self._users:
                return 409, None
            salt = secrets.token_bytes(16)
            self._users[username] = (salt, self._hash(salt, password))
            self._user_docs[username] = []
            self._payments[username] = []
            return 201, None

    def login(self, username, password):
        with self._lock:
            if not isinstance(username, str) or not isinstance(password, str):
                return 401, None
            rec = self._users.get(username)
            if rec is None:
                return 401, None
            salt, h = rec
            if not hmac.compare_digest(h, self._hash(salt, password)):
                return 401, None
            token = secrets.token_hex(16)
            self._tokens[token] = (username, self._clock.now())
            return 200, {"token": token}

    def logout(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            if self._auth(token) is None:
                return 401, None
            del self._tokens[token]
            return 204, None

    # ---------- documents ----------
    def create_document(self, token, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            self._doc_counter += 1
            doc_id = "doc-%d" % self._doc_counter
            self._docs[doc_id] = {
                "id": doc_id,
                "owner": user,
                "title": title,
                "content": content,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            self._seqs[doc_id] = self._doc_counter
            self._user_docs[user].append(doc_id)
            return 201, {"id": doc_id}

    def get_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def update_document(self, token, doc_id, title, content):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            if not self._valid_doc_fields(title, content):
                return 400, None
            doc["title"] = title
            doc["content"] = content
            return 200, dict(doc)

    def delete_document(self, token, doc_id):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            doc = self._owned(user, doc_id)
            if doc is None:
                return 404, None
            del self._docs[doc_id]
            del self._seqs[doc_id]
            self._user_docs[user].remove(doc_id)
            return 204, None

    def list_documents(self, token, page_size=20, cursor=None):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(page_size) or not (1 <= page_size <= 100):
                return 400, None
            last_seq = 0
            if cursor is not None:
                if not isinstance(cursor, str):
                    return 400, None
                entry = self._cursors.get(cursor)
                if entry is None or entry[0] != user:
                    return 400, None
                last_seq = entry[1]
            remaining = [d for d in self._user_docs[user] if self._seqs[d] > last_seq]
            page = remaining[:page_size]
            next_cursor = None
            if len(remaining) > page_size:
                next_cursor = secrets.token_hex(16)
                self._cursors[next_cursor] = (user, self._seqs[page[-1]])
            return 200, {
                "items": [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in page],
                "next_cursor": next_cursor,
            }

    def search_documents(self, token, query):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not isinstance(query, str) or query == "":
                return 400, None
            q = query.casefold()
            result = []
            for d in self._user_docs[user]:
                doc = self._docs[d]
                if q in doc["title"].casefold() or q in doc["content"].casefold():
                    result.append(dict(doc))
            return 200, result

    def export_documents(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(self._docs[d]) for d in self._user_docs[user]]

    # ---------- payments ----------
    def pay(self, token, amount_cents, idempotency_key):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            if not _is_int(amount_cents) or not (1 <= amount_cents <= 1000000):
                return 400, None
            if not isinstance(idempotency_key, str) or idempotency_key == "":
                return 400, None
            rec = self._pay_keys.get((user, idempotency_key))
            if rec is None:
                rec = {"amount": amount_cents, "payment": None}
                self._pay_keys[(user, idempotency_key)] = rec
            elif rec["amount"] != amount_cents:
                return 409, None
            elif rec["payment"] is not None:
                return 200, dict(rec["payment"])
            reference = "%s:%s" % (user, idempotency_key)
            try:
                self._gateway.charge(reference, amount_cents)
            except GatewayTimeout:
                return 504, None
            self._pay_counter += 1
            payment = {
                "id": "pay-%d" % self._pay_counter,
                "amount_cents": amount_cents,
                "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
                "created_at": self._clock.now(),
            }
            rec["payment"] = payment
            self._payments[user].append(payment)
            return 201, dict(payment)

    def list_payments(self, token):
        with self._lock:
            user = self._auth(token)
            if user is None:
                return 401, None
            return 200, [dict(p) for p in self._payments[user]]
```

```python file=test_phase_b.py
class FakeClock:

class FakeGateway:
    """Charges at most once per reference; can time out before or after charging."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charged = {}      # reference -> amount
        self.calls = 0
        self.script = []       # list of None | "before" | "after"

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls += 1
        mode = self.script.pop(0) if self.script else None
        if mode == "before":
            raise GatewayTimeout("timeout")
        if reference not in self.charged:
            self.charged[reference] = amount_cents
        if mode == "after":
            raise GatewayTimeout("timeout")
        return {"reference": reference}

@settings(max_examples=60, deadline=None)
def test_property_pagination_with_concurrent_changes(n, ps, actions):
    """Following cursors yields each remaining document exactly once, in creation order, despite creates and deletes between pages."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    all_ids = [doc(svc, tok) for _ in range(n)]
    live = list(all_ids)
    last_idx = -1
    collected = []
    cursor = None
    acts = list(actions)
    for _ in range(100):
        s, body = svc.list_documents(tok, ps, cursor)
        assert s == 200, f"cursor={cursor!r} output={(s, body)!r}"
        got = [d["id"] for d in body["items"]]
        remaining = [i for i in all_ids[last_idx + 1:] if i in live]
        assert got == remaining[:ps], f"n={n} ps={ps} actions={actions!r} got={got!r} expected={remaining[:ps]!r}"
        collected += got
        if got:
            last_idx = all_ids.index(got[-1])
        if len(remaining) > ps:
            assert body["next_cursor"] is not None, f"output={body!r}"
        if len(got) < ps:
            assert body["next_cursor"] is None, f"short page output={body!r}"
        cursor = body["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            break
        if acts:
            create, k = acts.pop(0)
            if create:
                nid = doc(svc, tok)
                all_ids.append(nid)
                live.append(nid)
            elif live:
                victim = live.pop(k % len(live))
                assert svc.delete_document(tok, victim)[0] == 204
    assert len(set(collected)) == len(collected), f"collected={collected!r}"
```
